annotation:
In the bustling city of New York, I was born and raised in a hardworking family. My parents, both immigrants, instilled in me the values of determination and perseverance from a young age. They worked tirelessly in their respective jobs, my father as a janitor and my mother as a seamstress, to provide my sister and me with every opportunity possible.

My early years were spent in a small apartment in Queens, surrounded by a vibrant community of diverse cultures and backgrounds. This upbringing sparked my curiosity and passion for learning about the world and its many intricacies. I remember spending hours at the local library, engrossed in books that took me on adventures to far-off places and allowed me to see the world through different lenses.

As I grew older, my love for learning led me to pursue higher education. I attended a prestigious university, where I studied psychology and sociology. These subjects fascinated me, as they delved into the complexities of human behavior, relationships, and societal structures. During my time at university, I became deeply involved in various research projects and social initiatives, further fueling my desire to make a positive impact on the world.

Post-graduation, I decided to move to San Francisco to explore opportunities in the tech industry. The city's innovative spirit and entrepreneurial culture drew me in, and I found myself working for a leading tech company, focusing on user experience design. This role enabled me to merge my passion for technology and human behavior, as I strived to create products that catered to users' needs while also pushing the boundaries of innovation.

Outside of my professional life, I am an avid volunteer and advocate for mental health awareness. I believe that everyone deserves access to mental health resources and support, regardless of their background or circumstances. As such, I dedicate much of my free time to working with organizations that focus on breaking down barriers and reducing stigmas surrounding mental health.

In my downtime, I enjoy exploring the beautiful landscapes of California, hiking, and practicing photography. Being in nature allows me to disconnect from the fast pace of city life and recharge my batteries. Photography, in particular, has become a creative outlet for me, as I experiment with different techniques and perspectives to capture the essence of the world around me.

My life has been shaped by the experiences and lessons I've gained along the way. From humble beginnings to pursuing my dreams, I have learned to embrace challenges, stay true to my values, and never lose sight of what truly matters. As I continue on this journey, I remain committed to making a difference in the lives of those around me and contributing positively to the communities I am part of.
